prompt: A rectangular flag measures $9$ inches by $12$ inches. A gold stripe runs corner to corner. How long is the stripe, in inches?
hint: A diagonal splits the rectangle into two right triangles whose legs are the sides of the rectangle.

hints.text: A diagonal splits the rectangle into two right triangles whose legs are the sides of the rectangle.

explanation: The two sides, $9$ and $12$, are the legs of a right triangle; the stripe is the hypotenuse.
$\sqrt{225} = 15$, so the gold stripe is $15$ inches long.

alternativeExplanations.title: Triple spotting saves time
steps: Once you recognize the family you can write $15$ immediately and use the squaring only as a check.
